title: Large-Step Last-Iterate Convergence of Random-Reshuffling Stochastic Gradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2610.19444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random reshuffling stochastic gradient descent (RR-SGD) is widely used for finite-sum optimization in machine learning. For convex $L$-smooth components, recent work establishes convergence guarantees for an averaged iterate with component stepsizes as large as order $1/L$. However, the final iterate is a natural output in practice, and existing last-iterate guarantees in this setting require stepsizes that scale inversely with the number of components $n$. We establish an expected objective-gap bound for the last iterate of standard RR-SGD on unconstrained problems with a constant component stepsize satisfying $0<\eta\lesssim 1/(L(1 + \log(nK)))$, where $K$ is the number of epochs. By retaining the sampling bias at random comparison points, we remove the explicit $1/n$ factor from the stepsize restriction. Combined with existing small-step bounds, our result matches the corresponding averaged-iterate convergence rate up to logarithmic

translated_title: 随机重排随机梯度下降的大步长末次迭代收敛性
translated_abstract: 随机重排随机梯度下降（RR-SGD）在机器学习中广泛应用于有限和优化问题。对于凸的 L-光滑分量函数，近期的工作为平均迭代点建立了收敛性保证，其分量步长可达到 1/L 的量级。然而，末次迭代点是实践中自然的输出，而现有在此设定下的末次迭代收敛保证要求步长与分量数 n 成反比。我们在无约束问题上为标准 RR-SGD 的末次迭代点建立了期望目标函数间隙界，所用常数分量步长满足 0<η≲1/(L(1+log(nK)))，其中 K 为训练轮数。通过在随机比较点保留采样偏差，我们从步长限制中移除了显式的 1/n 因子。结合现有的小步长界，我们的结果在对数因子内匹配了相应的平均迭代点收敛速率。
tldr: 本文为随机重排随机梯度下降（RR-SGD）的末次迭代点建立了大步长收敛保证，通过保留随机比较点的采样偏差，从步长限制中移除了显式的 1/n 因子，使末次迭代的收敛速率在对数因子内匹配平均迭代点的收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes large-step last-iterate convergence guarantees for random-reshuffling SGD, removing the explicit 1/n factor from the stepsize restriction by retaining sampling bias at random comparison points, so that the last-iterate convergence rate matches the averaged-iterate rate up to logarithmic factors.
